newsitem.title: FRANCE: US group said eyeing C.Lyonnais asset firm.
newsitem.headline: US group said eyeing C.Lyonnais asset firm.

text.p: A U.S. firm, reported by the South China Morning Post to be Nicholas-Applegate Capital Management, is in talks with French bank Credit Lyonnais about buying Credit Lyonnais International Asset Management (CLIAM), CL said..

A Credit Lyonnais spokesman told Reuters in reply to a query the state-owned French bank was talking to a U.S. firm and that this could result in a partial or total sale of the business, which he said operated in Hong Kong and Singapore.
The spokesman said CLIAM accounted for about one percent of the assets under management by the Credit Lyonnais group but said no decision had been taken.

"The issue is being considered with an American partner. It could lead to us selling all or a part of the capital of Credit Lyonnais Asset Management but nothing is decided at this stage," the Credit Lyonnais spokesman in Paris said.
He declined to name the U.S. group involved.

The South China Morning Post said negotiators for Credit Lyonnais and the California-based Nicholas Applegate Capital Management "were understood to be finalising the details of the sale" after two months of negotiations.
